title: Wgpu Glass Panel Crispness Fix
description: Restore real frosted-glass panels in the wgpu renderer (side panel, context menus/dropdowns, window measures/engagement rails) via GPU backdrop-blur + saturate + tint composite.
summary: Fixed two glass-blur bugs in the wgpu renderer. (1) blur_scratch now has a full mip chain matching scene_color so each downsample iteration copies into a correctly sized view, eliminating the shrunk/repeating backdrop artifact. (2) Added glass foreground layer support to DrawList (begin_glass_content/end_glass_content, foreground_of tagging, LayerBatchFilter) so panel/rail content renders crisply after glass compositing instead of being overwritten; migrated render_floating_panel and window-options rails. Added unit tests for foreground tagging and backdrop batch filtering. Wasm rebuild and headless Playwright check: 0 WebGPU errors, full canvas render (maxLuma 255). Also fixed infinite_world borrow error blocking wasm build.
